description: "Plain Sermons, preached at Archbishop Tenison's Chapel, Regent Street" by James Galloway Cowan is a collection of Christian sermons written in the mid-19th century. This work features a series of discourses aimed at exploring various theological themes, encouraging a deeper understanding of faith and morality among its listeners.
